stemMd: Which store format has the highest observed availability rate?

options.label: B
options.textMd: All categories have the same rate

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Convenience: 85/100=85%; Standard: 160/200=80%; Large: 270/300=90%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 90%.

distractorRationale.c: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 85%, 80%, 90%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.a: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 85%, 80%, 90%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.b: The ratios differ; equal rates cannot be inferred from the raw totals.
